description: Where an action_id does appear more than once, its rows must not disagree about status.
why_it_exists: A duplicate row is recoverable if both copies say the same thing. Two rows for one action_id carrying different statuses means the register itself cannot answer whether the action is done, and 'last row wins' is a guess, not a fact. The census separates plain duplicates from conflicting duplicates for exactly this reason.

expect.resolution_rule: none - a conflicting duplicate must be escalated, never auto-resolved by taking the last row

assertions: For every action_id with more than one row, the set of upper-cased status values across those rows has size 1.
Any conflicting action_id is reported with every row's sheet row number, status and blocked_reason (first 60 characters).
The harness must not silently pick a winner between conflicting statuses.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "invariant": not executed by harness/run.js.
